title: 🎰 Events & Banners
text:
The bot keeps an **Active now** board at the bottom of this room with every live event and summon banner and how long it lasts. It updates **by itself** from the official Dragonheir calendars.

💬 **Chat here**: who is summoning, who got what, is the banner worth it.
⏰ The bot warns here when something has **less than 24 hours left**.
📋 Type `/events` in any room to see the list.

**Officers** can fix anything the calendar misses:
• `/event scan` + a screenshot from the game: the bot reads it
• `/event add` / `/event remove` by hand
• `/event serverday` to set today's server day (from Timesand Trail)
